messages.author: 24e378928ea36cc0
messages.subject: Copy selection to clipboard
parts:
Hello-

I currently have a table setup where users can click on a certain row, and the shiny server can grab the selected row. I would like a user to be able to click on the row, and automatically copy the selection to the user's clipboard. Is this possible in shiny? 

Thanks,
Summer

messages.subject: Re: Copy selection to clipboard
parts:
I have heard many times that it is possible with the plugin
http://datatables.net/extensions/tabletools/, but I have not really
tried it yet. You can search for tabletools in the mailing list, and I
remember I gave a sketch solution once. I will certainly take a
serious look at all the DataTables plugins and make some examples once
I have got time. If you are going to experiment with it, please read
this post first:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/-0u-wTnq_lA

Regards,
Yihui
